bf16.method: BF16 baseline: every weight in bf16, no quantization.

fp32.method: FP32 reference: every weight in fp32, no quantization.

fp8_w8a8.method: FP8 W8A8, real compute path: weights per-output-channel e4m3, activations dynamically per-token e4m3, matmul via torch._scaled_mm on CPU.

int4_awq_g128.method: AWQ core (from-scratch implementation of Lin et al.): activation-aware per-input-channel scaling, alpha grid search minimizing layer output error on calibration inputs, INT4 group-128.

int4_gptq_g128.method: GPTQ (from-scratch implementation of Frantar et al.): INT4 group-128, Hessian from 2048 calibration tokens of a disjoint Alice slice, per-column error compensation.

int4_rtn_g128.method: Weight-only INT4: group-128 (input dim) symmetric round-to-nearest (from scratch), packed 2 codes/byte.

int4_rtn_pc.method: Weight-only INT4: per-output-channel symmetric round-to-nearest (from scratch), packed 2 codes/byte.

int8_rtn.method: Weight-only INT8: per-output-channel symmetric round-to-nearest (from scratch), dequantized to fp32 on the fly.

15b_bf16.method: BF16 baseline: every weight in bf16, no quantization.
